title: Qualify a browser candidate for independent customer use
goal: Establish that the actual browser candidate supports its declared customer use.
context: An identifiable browser candidate and declared compatibility scope are available.
trigger: The maintainer prepares the browser capability for a supported release.
preconditions: The selected scope and any available project or artifact identity are explicitly identified.

interaction.action: Selects the exact candidate and declared supported environments.
Makes its identity, resources and dependency/profile contract available for assessment.
Exercises customer generation and offline reading with an independent model.
Retains actual results and explicit gaps tied to the candidate without claiming publication.

expected_outcome: The maintainer has attributable qualification evidence for actual customer use.

alternatives.condition: A reference architecture site is also prepared.
alternatives.outcome: Its separate content identity and scope remain distinguishable from the reusable product.

failures.condition: A resource is missing or a profile/dependency is incompatible.
failures.outcome: Qualification fails for that scope without substituting a sample-site result.
Actual effects and recovery limits are reported while customer definitions and unrelated content remain protected.

sources.locator: SCN-087; confirmed as requirement-analysis knowledge by the scoped author assessment, not independent review or executed product proof.
sources.basis: User-requested reusable customer architecture browser; requirement-level author analysis. Current records remain draft; no implemented, published or independently approved behavior is claimed.
